title: Hector imagines Troy's fall
intro: Hector's public shame and private fear collide. His speech shifts between future prediction, possible scenes of captivity, and a final wish.

notes.text: ἐνίσπω 3sg aor, told; θεοπρόπιον gen pl, divine messages / oracles, dependent on εὖ εἰδώς, knowing well.
ἐποτρύνω, urge on; ἄνωγα, command, here a present-form 3sg. Subject θυμός, their own spirit.
With flashing helmet; κόρυς, helmet, + αἰόλος, glittering / shifting.
μέλω 3sg pres impersonal, is a concern to, with dat ἐμοί; γυνή voc sg γύναι.
Feel shame before / respect, with acc of the people whose judgment matters.
ἑλκεσίπεπλος, trailing-robed; acc pl fem. The compound evokes long robes drawn along the ground.
αἴ = εἰ, if; ἀλυσκάζω pres subj 1sg after κε, avoid / shrink away from. πολέμοιο gen of separation.
Like a coward, apart. Postposed ὥς bears an accent; νόσφιν, away / aloof.
μανθάνω 1sg unaugmented aor; εἰμί pres inf epic ἔμμεναι. ἐσθλός stays nom because its subject is also the main verb's subject.
πρῶτος dat pl, among the foremost; ἄρνυμαι pres mid ptc, winning / seeking to win, with acc κλέος.
In mind and heart; paired expressions emphasize deep conviction.
εἰμί 3sg fut; ὄλλυμι 3sg perf subj active, with intransitive sense, has perished. ὅτ᾽ ἄν: when the time comes that Troy is gone.
ἐϋμμελίης, skilled with the ash spear: gen sg epic -εω / -ω type, agreeing with Πριάμοιο.
τόσσον = τοσοῦτον, so much; balanced by ὅσσον at 454. ὀπίσσω, here in the future.
πίπτω 3pl aor opt with κεν: who might fall. πολέες = πολλοί; despite being many and brave.
κονίη dat pl, dust; δυσμενής dat pl, hostile. ὑπό + dat marks the hands / agency of their enemies.
σεῦ = σοῦ, gen: grief for you; δακρυόεις acc sg fem, tearful. The latter describes Andromache, object of ἄγηται.
ἄγω 3sg aor subj mid, carry off for oneself; ἀπαυράω aor ptc nom sg masc, having taken away.
The day of freedom: free life or free status, opposed to δούλιον ἦμαρ at 463.
πρός + gen, at another woman's bidding; ὑφαίνω 2sg pres opt with κεν, might weave. ἱστός: loom, here its web.
φορέω 2sg pres opt, uncontracted; carry repeatedly, here water-fetching as an enslaved woman's task.
Genitives of spring names, Messeis and Hypereia: water from either spring. The names evoke a distant Greek setting.
ἀεκάζομαι pres mid ptc fem, being unwilling / against your will; πόλλα adverbial, sorely.
ἐπίκειμαι 3sg fut, will lie upon; ἀνάγκη, constraint / necessity. Elided -ται before ἀνάγκη.
εἶπον 3sg aor subj with epic ending -ῃσι; independent anticipatory subj, someone will say / may well say.
ἀριστεύω iterative impf 3sg, used to excel; ἀμφιμάχομαι 3pl impf, fought around / for Troy.
ἐρέω 3sg uncontracted fut, will say; belongs to the suppletive system λέγω / εἶπον / ἐρῶ.
χῆτος dat sg, for lack of; gen τοιοῦδ᾽ ἀνδρός. Inf describes the missing man's capacity: a man to ward off enslavement.
θνῄσκω perf ptc acc sg masc, dead; καλύπτω 3sg pres opt of wish, may it cover. χυτὴ γαῖα: earth heaped into a grave.
ἑλκηθμός gen sg, dragging away; πυνθάνομαι aor mid inf after πρίν, before learning / hearing, with gen of what is heard.
